tabs.tab_title: Do I really need surgery for my kidney stone?
tabs.tab_content: Not always. Many stones can pass or be cleared with a laser, no big cut. Dr. Dalvi will tell you what your case needs.

tabs.tab_title: Is it too late to fix my prostate or urine problem?
tabs.tab_content: It’s rarely too late. These problems respond well at almost any stage. The sooner you come, the easier it usually is.

tabs.tab_title: I’m embarrassed about my problem. Will this be private?
tabs.tab_content: Completely. Whatever it is — men’s health, leaking, swelling — you’ll be heard with respect. No judgement. Ever.

tabs.tab_title: My reports came back "normal," but I still feel something’s wrong.
tabs.tab_content: You’re not imagining it. Sometimes the answer is in details a quick test misses. Dr. Dalvi looks closer until you have a real answer.

tabs.tab_title: Why choose Dr. Dalvi over other doctors?
tabs.tab_content: Top training (MCh from Sion, Mumbai). 11+ years. 10,000+ patients. But mostly, he’s honest, and he listens.

tabs.tab_title: How do I book an appointment?
tabs.tab_content: Easy. Tap the "Book an Appointment" button, or call the clinic. Just pick a time that suits you.

tabs.tab_title: Will my child’s urology problem need an operation?
tabs.tab_content: Often not. Children’s cases are handled gently, with surgery only as a last resort.

tabs.tab_title: Do you help with kidney failure and dialysis?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. We provide AV fistula creation and dialysis support to keep you safe and cared for.
